label: Areas
description: Manages application navigation areas, menu slot selection, and routes.

globalPrefix.description: Effective reserved path prefix for application-wide Navigation.

xshell:area:change.description: Emitted on the Bus when navigation changes the current area.

areaId.description: Identifier of the newly selected area.

getAreas.description: Returns the ordered array of configured Areas with their read-only route descriptors.

getArea.description: Returns the Area with the specified ID, or null. Its ordered routes expose path, href, and the target's module ID or null.

getDefaultArea.description: Returns the default area, falling back to the first area, or null.

getCurrentArea.description: Returns the currently selected area or the default area.

resolveAreaId.description: Resolves an Area ID using the longest matching Area prefix. Returns null for global URLs or when no Area matches.

getModuleId.description: Extracts the module ID from a URL containing the configured module-assets base path, or returns null.
